notes.title: INTERASTRA - Early Access Release -
notes.content:
Info from the Dev Team:

[i]We just wanted to inform you that today is the premiere of INTERASTRA in Steam Early Access. We are delighted to create the biggest game in our portfolio with our hard work. At the same time, we would like to point out that this is early access, and the game will be gradually developed, we will keep you informed about any updates. We hope you enjoy INTERASTRA and welcome your valuable feedback. Don't forget about today's live stream (09.02.2022, 15:00 CET) and about the giveaway, which the results will be announced tomorrow (10.02.2022).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37280737/5cc9f266b38cd41296da15ab53b61c0ea96a3b2b.png[/img]

All the best,
INTERASTRA's Dev Team!
